svg.aria-label: insect-frass-vision overview: insects and frass are segmented from a camera view, a serpentine suction path is planned, written to a Siemens S7 PLC, and the insects are picked up along the path.
svg.text: Insects cluster on their own. A camera and YOLO11n-seg
find them, a suction path is planned through each cluster,
and a Siemens S7 PLC drives the machine to pick them up.
